# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by config::reference. See development.md to regenerate. -->

Every entry in `config.toml` is optional. Defaults below apply before command-line overrides.
See the [configuration guide](configuration.md#config-file) for the file location and a working example.

## Top-level settings

| Key | TOML type | Default | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `app_icon` | string | `"tide"` | Choose an [app icon](usage.md#app-icons): `"tide"`, `"lagoon"`, `"dusk"`, `"reef"`, `"kelp"`, `"midnight"`, `"golden"`, `"sunset"`. |
| `auto_secure_input` | boolean | `true` | Enable Secure Keyboard Entry at password prompts on macOS. |
| `clipboard_read` | boolean | `false` | Allow programs to read the clipboard with OSC 52. |
| `colors` | table of strings | From the theme | Override individual [palette colors](#colors) in both light and dark themes. |
| `compare_runs` | boolean or table | `true` | Mark output that changed since the previous run of the same command. See [compare_runs](#compare_runs). |
| `confirm_close` | boolean | `true` | Confirm before closing a tab or window with a running program. |
| `desktop_notifications` | boolean | `true` | Allow programs to request desktop notifications with OSC 9, 777 or 99. |
| `drop_preview` | boolean | `true` | Show a preview when dropping a supported file. Disable to insert only its quoted path. |
| `editor` | string or array of strings | `$VISUAL`, then `$EDITOR` | Open [file links](usage.md#links) with this command. Use an array for arguments containing spaces. |
| `env` | table of strings | `{}` | Set environment variables for child processes, overriding inherited values. |
| `font` | string | Bundled JetBrains Mono | Choose a font family or font file. See [Fonts](configuration.md#fonts). |
| `font_bold` | string | From `font` | Override the bold face with a family name or file. |
| `font_bold_italic` | string | From `font` | Override the bold italic face with a family name or file. |
| `font_italic` | string | From `font` | Override the italic face with a family name or file. |
| `font_size` | number | `14.0` | Set the font size in points, from 4 to 200. |
| `hide_mouse_when_typing` | boolean | `true` | Hide the pointer while sending keyboard input. Moving the mouse shows it again. |
| `hover_preview` | boolean | `false` | Preview a file path when holding Cmd (macOS) or Ctrl (Linux) over it. |
| `keybindings` | table of bindings | [Platform shortcuts](usage.md#keyboard-and-mouse) | Map a chord to an action name or `{ send = "text" }`. Use `"none"` to unbind. See [Key bindings](configuration.md#key-bindings). |
| `menu_bar_icon` | boolean | `true` | Show the Trident menu bar item on macOS. |
| `notify_long_commands_after` | integer | `10` | Notify when a command finishes in an unfocused tab after at least this many seconds. Set to 0 to disable. |
| `padding` | number | `6.0` | Set the space around the grid in logical pixels, from 0 to 1000. |
| `pager` | string or array of strings | `["less", "-R", "+G"]` | Open the last command’s output with this program. Trident appends the output file path. |
| `paste_protection` | boolean | `true` | Confirm a paste containing line breaks or control characters outside bracketed paste mode. See [Paste](usage.md#paste). |
| `remember_window_size` | boolean | `true` | Restore the last window size and maximized state unless a row or column count is set. |
| `scrollback` | integer or table | `10000` | Keep this many lines of history. Set to 0 to disable or use the [scrollback](#scrollback) table to limit each command. |
| `shell` | string or array of strings | Login shell | Start this program in the terminal. Use an array to pass arguments. |
| `tab_bar` | string | `"always"` | On Linux, use `"always"`, `"auto"` (two or more tabs) or `"never"`. macOS uses native tabs. |
| `term` | string | `"xterm-256color"` | Set `TERM` for child processes. A missing [terminfo entry](usage.md#terminfo) falls back to `xterm-256color`. |
| `theme` | string or table | `"tokyo-night"` | Use a bundled name, a theme file, `"auto"` or a table with both `light` and `dark` names or paths. See [Color themes](configuration.md#color-themes). |
| `trim_paste` | boolean | `true` | Remove trailing whitespace from a single-line paste, including its final newline. |
| `visual_bell` | boolean | `false` | Flash the grid when a program rings the bell. |
| `vsync` | boolean | `true` | Wait for the display refresh before presenting a frame. Disabling this may cause tearing. |
| `window_columns` | integer | Saved width or 100 | Set the first window’s width in cells, from 1 to 10000. |
| `window_rows` | integer | Saved height or 30 | Set the first window’s height in cells, from 1 to 10000. |

## scrollback

Use `[scrollback]` instead of the integer form. Per-command limits require [shell integration](configuration.md#shell-integration).

| Key | TOML type | Default | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `lines` | integer | `10000` | Set the total history size in lines. |
| `command_budget` | boolean | `true` | Drop the middle of oversized command output instead of evicting the oldest history first. |
| `command_share` | number | `0.5` | Set the fraction of history one command may use, greater than 0 and at most 1. |

## compare_runs

Use `[compare_runs]` instead of the boolean form to customize [output comparison](configuration.md#compare-runs).

| Key | TOML type | Default | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | boolean | `true` | Compare successive runs marked by shell integration. |
| `default_ignore` | boolean | `true` | Ignore built-in patterns such as timestamps and process IDs. |
| `ignore` | array of strings | `[]` | Add regular expressions for text to ignore on each line. |

## colors

Use quoted `#rrggbb` strings in `[colors]`. These are the defaults without a theme override.

| --- | --- |
